limitation: Frozen non-system ordering can prevent new CoT→assistant swaps, but CoT can still become system and five-way accuracy is not mathematically guaranteed. System tail P/R/F1 depend entirely on corrected system score and one globaltau; this design cannot promise tail repair. Botharms reuse one base and one residual seed; all current validation is developer data, with overlapping tails/public groups and shared system wording components.
